description:
Implement the spec in .openspec/specs/design-knowledge/spec.md in the factory.

Build, per the spec scenarios:

S1: an original design knowledge base authored for ANVIL, as data files under design-knowledge/ at the factory root: styles.json, palettes.json (organized by product type), fonts.json, guidelines.json and product-types.json, in the factory's voice, a starter dataset. A loader validates each entry's required fields and fails naming the file and entry when one is malformed.

S2: matching is deterministic: a project's declared product type (a product_type field in design/tokens.json or design/DESIGN.md, or the project brain) selects the product type note plus the styles, palettes and pairings it references and the general guidelines; the same type always selects the same slice.

S3: packets for reviewer-design and for the design authoring path (a station whose work order targets design/DESIGN.md, and the builder or writer on that path) gain a Design knowledge section with the matched slice and the authority statement; other stations' packets are unchanged. Compute the slice once per run, like the project design section.

S4: authority is explicit everywhere: the injected section and reviewer-design's contract state that the project's design system is the authority, that the knowledge is reference material, and that a deviation from the knowledge base alone is never a finding.

S5: an undeclared or unknown product type selects the general guidelines only, and the packet records that no product type slice matched.

S6: citation discipline in the station contracts: a design system authored or revised with the knowledge base cites the entries it drew from in a Design knowledge sources note in DESIGN.md (file and entry name), and reviewer-design names the knowledge entry behind any suggestion it makes.

Tests covering S1 to S6 in the factory suite style, docs updated (a docs page describing the knowledge base and its authority rule), CHANGELOG Unreleased updated. Keep the whole suite green and every pipeline valid.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/arananet/anvil-factory/issues/11
title: Design knowledge base for the design stations
